report.model_summary: Paid Nov-2009 claims rose from $13,004,780 (1,442 claims) to $17,566,180 (1,878 claims), +$4,561,400 (+35%) with no query change. Pending Nov claims fell from 188 claims ($2,150,100) to 3 claims ($46,000) as late claims were adjudicated to paid, plus additional late-arriving claims; total Nov cohort grew from 1,678 to 1,936 rows. Reversals correctly included per contract went from -$116,000 to -$369,000, dates and grain are correct with no duplicates.
